subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should the prepared model-catalog readers remain public Plugin SDK APIs with `loadModelCatalog` retained as a deprecated compatibility wrapper, or should this lifecycle capability stay internal behind a narrower supported SDK seam?
rationale: The branch adds a durable plugin-facing lifecycle API and a deprecated compatibility route; code review can verify mechanics, but maintainers must choose the permanent external contract and deprecation path.

options.title: Keep the narrow compatibility wrapper
options.body: Retain `loadModelCatalog` as documented deprecated source compatibility while new internal and bundled callers use the prepared-runtime API, with focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Design a narrower SDK seam
options.body: Pause the SDK export decision and replace the new broad catalog readers with a dedicated owner-approved plugin contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the narrow compatibility wrapper
recommendation.body: Retain `loadModelCatalog` as documented deprecated source compatibility while new internal and bundled callers use the prepared-runtime API, with focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author carried the lifecycle and SDK-boundary refactor through its final generation-boundary commits.
